purpose: Targeted industrial-mechanism and prior-art review for two separate complementary instruments
method: Primary-source discovery, citation chaining, author-repository copies, targeted results/methods inspection, and exact-version code probes. Not a preregistered systematic review or exhaustive market census.

sources.title: Minimizing acetate formation from overflow metabolism in Escherichia coli: comparison of genetic engineering strategies to improve robustness toward sugar gradients in large-scale fermentation processes
sources.fact: The most effective acetate-reduction strategy differed between unrestricted growth and carbon-limited glucose-shock conditions.
sources.limit: An industrial strain and industrial motivation; the reported experiments are microplate and small-bioreactor tests, not a validated universal scale-transfer rule.
sources.implication: Represent process regime and target environment in comparison eligibility.

sources.title: Combined oxygen and glucose oscillations distinctly change the transcriptional and physiological state of Escherichia coli
sources.fact: Combined glucose/oxygen oscillations produced responses distinct from the isolated oscillations; some transcriptional responses persisted.
sources.limit: The 90 m³ environment is modeled; actual measurements are from scale-down experiments.
sources.implication: Store realized trajectories, temporal alignment, stress history, and model-versus-observation roles.
sources.location: Abstract; Results; Materials and methods; Data availability

sources.title: Diverse genetic error modes constrain large-scale bio-based production
sources.fact: Production loss was associated with changing population genetics in engineered E. coli despite plasmid selection.
sources.limit: Serial-passage simulation and a simplified population model; not a survey establishing industrial prevalence.
sources.implication: Separate intended design from observed population state and attach verification to time, material, method, and coverage.

sources.title: Interlaboratory comparison for quantitative primary metabolite profiling in Pichia pastoris
sources.fact: Reported expanded combined uncertainties (K=2) were 21–48% and 30–57%; most concentrations agreed within uncertainty.
sources.limit: Specific intracellular metabolites and methods; these ranges are not a universal error model for product titer.
sources.implication: Represent metrological uncertainty separately from arithmetic precision and replicate variation.

sources.title: Optimized Fast Filtration-Based Sampling and Extraction Enables Precise and Absolute Quantification of the Escherichia coli Central Carbon Metabolome
sources.fact: Sampling, extraction, leakage, and residual salts affected measurement quality.
sources.limit: Full-text retrieval was blocked; conclusions here are restricted to indexed author text, not a reanalysis of the method.
sources.implication: Track sample handling and matrix evidence; an extraction-protocol identifier alone does not validate a measurement.

sources.title: A machine learning Automated Recommendation Tool for synthetic biology
sources.kind: method, simulations, retrospective examples and experimental demonstration
sources.fact: ART provides probabilistic recommendations and documents both successful examples and weak prediction in the dodecanol case.
sources.limit: Data requirements depended on the problem; prediction accuracy and successful experimental recommendation were not equivalent endpoints.
sources.implication: Reuse recommendation engines and test prospective decision utility independently of model fit.

sources.title: Lessons from Two Design–Build–Test–Learn Cycles of Dodecanol Production in Escherichia coli Aided by Machine Learning
sources.fact: Authors identified expression-control limitations, build effects, training-data limitations, and the need to check production-strain plasmids.
sources.limit: Publisher full text was inaccessible during this review; detailed independent interpretation also uses S06, which explicitly reexamines this case.
sources.implication: Record failed builds, intended-versus-observed constructs, and actuator uncertainty.

sources.title: Machine learning framework for assessment of microbial factory performance
sources.fact: Authors described burdens of manual curation, nonstandard metrics, undefined media, and omitted stability/byproduct context.
sources.limit: A literature-derived modeling study; its observations do not establish the present-day prevalence or cost of every bottleneck.
sources.implication: Capture denominator semantics, curation decisions, missingness, and experimental grouping before ML export.
sources.location: Model improvement; Data preprocessing and augmentation; Supporting information

sources.title: teemi: An open-source literate programming approach for iterative design-build-test-learn cycles in bioengineering
sources.kind: software method with a yeast engineering testbed
sources.fact: Literate workflows connected design, observed genotypes, production measurements, and iterative learning; plate reference measurements were used for normalization.
sources.limit: A specific experimental demonstration, not a controlled comparison proving universal error reduction or novice usability.
sources.implication: Benchmark against workflow reuse; version normalization controls and include curator workload.
sources.location: Results: cycles I and II; learning curves; Data availability

sources.title: Machine learning-led semi-automated medium optimization reveals salt as key for flaviolin production in Pseudomonas putida
sources.fact: Campaign 1 improved an optical proxy by 148% and directly measured HPLC titer by 70%; authors explicitly distinguished and validated these endpoints.
sources.limit: One host/product setting; method and metric transfer need validation.
sources.implication: Preserve proxy-versus-direct assay identity and link validation evidence rather than equate endpoints.
sources.location: Pipeline description; Results campaign 1; repeatability tests; Methods

sources.title: Author Correction: Machine learning-led semi-automated medium optimization reveals salt as key for flaviolin production in Pseudomonas putida
sources.fact: The correction repairs an author's misspelled surname.
sources.limit: This notice does not report a numerical correction.
sources.implication: Classify correction scope; do not invalidate quantitative conclusions merely because a correction exists.
sources.location: Entire one-page correction plus repository cover

sources.title: Automation and machine learning drive rapid optimization of isoprenol production in Pseudomonas putida
sources.fact: The study combines automation, multiplexed perturbations, validation, and ML to improve isoprenol production.
sources.limit: PDF metadata was retrievable, but later body requests failed. No detailed effect-size or QC-algorithm claim is used here.
sources.implication: Compare with validated acquisition-to-learning workflows rather than assume storage is the only constraint.

sources.title: A Robust Isotope Ratio LC–MS/MS Workflow for High-Throughput Metabolic Profiling of Bacteria
sources.fact: A recent study reports an isotope-ratio workflow for bacterial intracellular metabolite profiling.
sources.limit: Full-text retrieval remained blocked; final article DOI was confirmed in the primary indexed record. No independent assay reanalysis was performed.
sources.implication: Evaluate established quantitative assays; software replay should consume their evidence without claiming to replace them.

sources.title: FAIR data pipeline: provenance-driven data management for traceable scientific workflows
sources.kind: scientific software architecture and worked examples
sources.fact: The pipeline tracks data/code provenance and propagates issues to affected downstream outputs.
sources.limit: Developed for epidemiological workflows; not an industrial metabolic-engineering performance trial.
sources.implication: Correction-sensitive provenance is established prior art; compare an extension before building a production replacement.
sources.location: Requirements; architecture; examples; trust and quality

sources.title: Multiomics Data Collection, Visualization, and Utilization for Guiding Metabolic Engineering
sources.fact: ICE, EDD and ART form an integrated workflow; multiomics data in part of the demonstration are generated computationally.
sources.limit: The paper explicitly labels simulated omics and assumptions; it is not evidence that all displayed multiomics are real instrument measurements.
sources.implication: Reuse integration patterns and label simulation, observed evidence, and inference distinctly.
sources.location: Methods; generating multiomics; Results and discussion

sources.title: Abstraction hierarchy to define biofoundry workflows and operations for interoperable synthetic biology research and applications
sources.fact: The authors propose a hierarchy for biofoundry workflow interoperability.
sources.limit: A perspective is not an empirical demonstration that standards eliminate integration cost.
sources.implication: Use workflow/process vocabularies as integration candidates; require round-trip tests.
sources.location: Indexed perspective abstract and framework extracts

sources.title: Data-efficient hybrid parameter scaling for accurate microbial bioreactor scale-up
sources.fact: The analysis reuses lipase time courses from Geraats (1994) across several scales.
sources.limit: Historical curve reuse is not new prospective industrial validation; final DOI and full methods were not recovered.
sources.implication: Track original experiment identity and held-out scales to avoid counting reused evidence as new replication.

sources.title: Physiological responses to mixing in large scale bioreactors
sources.fact: E. coli fed-batch cultivations at 22 m³ were compared with laboratory and scale-down processes.
sources.limit: An older, specific process comparison; no generalized prevalence or present-day cost estimate is inferred.
sources.implication: Anchor scale-transfer challenges in measured large-scale experiments as well as modern simulations.

limits: No original experimental dataset was independently reproduced in this campaign.
No private industrial data, paid platform hands-on evaluation, or participating laboratory was available.
Access depth is recorded per source; blocked sources support only the limited indexed claims listed.
The four existing ME2026 forensic cases were not re-adjudicated.
No finding of misconduct or false biological results is implied by incomplete public evidence.
